newsitem.title: USA: Champion Enterprises expects record year.
newsitem.headline: Champion Enterprises expects record year.

text.p: Champion Enterprises Inc said 1996 is expected to be a record year for the company based on year-to-date results.

Earlier Wednesday, the manufactured housing company, reported third-quarter earnings rose to $13.3 million or $0.40 per share from $9.6 million or $0.30 per share a year ago. Sales gained to $273.8 million from $215.1 million.
The company also said its previously announced proposed merger with Redman Industries Inc will be considered by shareholders of both companies on October 24.
"The combination of Champion and Redman should result in a stronger and even more profitable organization," said Champion chairman Walter Young in a statement.
Young added that the company remains committed to its three-year goal of at least 20 percent compound annual growth in earnings per share.
